transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’m constantly revved up at work, taking on too many projects at once and I can’t slow my mind or my pace down. It's got to the point where I'm just completely overwhelmed and can't seem to stop.

Have there been times when you felt unusually high or irritable for several days, needed much less sleep, and still had lots of energy? During those times, did you do things that were out of character, like spending too much, talking much more, or taking big risks?

Yes, absolutely—I often stay up until 3 or 4 AM working on spreadsheets, sleep only a couple of hours, and wake up feeling completely wired and energized. My mood swings from feeling on top of the world to getting really snappy, and I've done some risky things like putting expensive software on my credit card, driving too fast, and sending flirty messages to clients. In the moment, it all just feels like part of this big, exciting plan I have.

Have you ever had a separate period lasting at least 2 weeks when you felt very down or lost interest in things most of the day, nearly every day? If so, did it happen outside of these high-energy periods?

Yes, I’ve had times where I feel completely flat and empty rather than deeply sad, and I just stay home staring at my laptop and ignoring my friends because I don't care about anything. Those low-energy periods have definitely happened for a couple of weeks at a time when I wasn't in my usual high-energy, sped-up state. It's like my motivation completely vanishes and I just shut down.
